items.title: Start a session as a draft
items.body: Write first, then pick the project and worktree. The session is created when you send.

items.title: Follow a /goal
items.body: See the session goal in Session Chat, and pause or clear it from its sheet.

items.title: Floating pills in Session Chat
items.body: Branch changes, background work from subagents and shells, and anything waiting on you, always in reach.

items.title: Images as galleries
items.body: Images in a message show inline and open full screen.

items.title: Deny with a note
items.body: Tell the agent what to do instead when you deny a permission.

items.title: Search and restore sessions
items.body: Search sessions on Home, and bring archived sessions back.

items.title: Keyboard and mouse
items.body: Shortcuts and pointer support with a hardware keyboard or mouse.

items.title: Attach any file
items.body: Attach videos and other files when your server supports streamed uploads.

items.title: Paste and drop attachments
items.body: Paste or drop files into Session Chat. Large files upload as they stream.

items.title: What's new
items.body: This screen. Find past releases any time in Settings.

items.title: Select and copy text
items.body: Select part of a message, and copy a whole code block in one tap.

items.title: Steering messages in the timeline
items.body: Messages you send while the agent works now show where they landed.

items.title: Message times
items.body: Drag your message to the left to see when you sent it.

items.title: Sheets open halfway
items.body: Drag a sheet up to full height, or down to close it.

items.title: Faster server switching
items.body: Switching servers no longer waits for the old one to answer.

items.title: Support the project
items.body: Rate the app, star it on GitHub, or follow along on X from Settings.

items.title: Prompts send right away
items.body: Prompts send directly, with Retry if one gets stuck.

items.title: Back gesture
items.body: Going back no longer opens message actions.

items.title: Crash fixes
items.body: Switching servers on Home and selecting text with a mouse no longer crash.

items.title: Ask a side question
items.body: Use /btw to ask something without interrupting the session.

items.title: Paste and drop attachments
items.body: Paste or drop files into Session Chat. Large files upload as they stream.

items.title: Source code in About
items.body: Settings links to the app's source code.

items.title: Inverted pairing QR codes
items.body: Light-on-dark pairing QR codes now scan.

items.title: Worktrees
items.body: Create worktrees from the app and see their sessions grouped under the project on Home.

items.title: Timeline styles
items.body: Choose how Session Chat shows the agent's work: step rail or activity cards.

items.title: Run shell commands
items.body: Start a message with ! to run it as a shell command.

items.title: Inspect tool results
items.body: Open any tool call to see its full input and output.

items.title: Several skills per prompt
items.body: Mention skills inline, as many as you need.

items.title: Compact Home rows
items.body: Denser session rows, with a Classic option in Settings.

items.title: Rate limits
items.body: A countdown and next steps when a provider limits your usage.

items.title: Safer connections
items.body: Saved addresses are checked without sending your password.

items.title: New project loading
items.body: Home shows progress while a newly added project's sessions load.

items.title: Archive on newer servers
items.body: Archiving sessions works again on OpenCode 2.1 and later.

items.title: Server upgrades
items.body: The app reconnects when your server switches protocol versions.

items.title: Crash fixes
items.body: Fixed crashes when live updates or worktrees reconnect.

items.title: Android 7 support
items.body: The app launches on Android 7 again.

items.title: New project loading
items.body: Home shows progress while a newly added project's sessions load.

items.title: Tablet split view
items.body: Home, Settings, Changes and Terminals side by side, with keyboard shortcuts.

items.title: Dictation
items.body: Dictate prompts in the composer.

items.title: Mention files
items.body: Type @ to add a file from your project to a prompt.

items.title: Browse files
items.body: Open a read-only file browser from Session Chat.

items.title: Fork a session
items.body: Fork from the Session Chat menu or from any message.

items.title: Pair with a code
items.body: Scan a pairing QR code or type the pairing code to connect.

items.title: Report a problem
items.body: Send feedback from inside the app.

items.title: iPhone Duo
items.body: Layouts for every iPhone Duo pose.

items.title: Branch and changes
items.body: A Session Chat pill shows the branch and working-tree changes. Worktree sessions show on Home.

items.title: Add any project
items.body: Type a path or browse other drives, with suggestions from your server.

items.title: New shell
items.body: Start a new shell from the Terminals screen.

items.title: Reliable sends
items.body: Prompts are kept when the connection drops while sending.

items.title: Crash fixes
items.body: Fixed the crashes reported in 1.0.0.

items.title: Connect to your opencode server
items.body: Over your LAN, VPN, HTTPS or a tunnel. Passwords stay in the device keychain.

items.title: All your sessions
items.body: See every project's sessions on Home, with live status.

items.title: Live Session Chat
items.body: Follow the agent as it works and send prompts from your phone.

items.title: Permissions and questions
items.body: Answer the agent's permission requests and questions from anywhere.
